views.title: Performance, Thermal & Global Super Fast Charger Engine (A10)

views.markdown:
### 🚀 Engineered for A10 Fusion & iOS 15.8.x

NovaShield is a production-grade rootless jailbreak tweak specifically designed to eliminate severe thermal throttling, `thermalmonitord` I2C bus hangs, slow charging, and memory pressure stalls during demanding tasks like **Mobile Legends: Bang Bang (MLBB)**, **Telegram group chats**, and **HD video calls**.

---

### ⚡ Key Features (v1.1.0)

* **⚡️ Global Super Fast Charger Engine**: Eliminates slow charging on iPhone 7 Plus by preventing A10 thermal throttling from dropping charging current to 0.8A. Maintains full 2.1A/2.4A fast charging profile.
* **❄️ Charge Heat Shield**: Automatically freezes heavy background indexing daemons (`backupd`, `suggestd`, `cloudphotod`, `mediaanalysisd`) while connected to power, keeping battery cool (<36°C).
* **💎 On-Screen Boot Proof Banner**: Displays a sleek Apple-style glassmorphic HUD directly on screen upon respring/boot confirming active hook status.
* **🌙 Zero Standby Battery Drain**: Automatically hooks `SBBacklightController` and Darwin screen notifications to suspend all CPU telemetry and timers when the screen is locked.
* **📊 Low-Overhead Mach Telemetry**: Real-time multi-core CPU load calculation directly via Mach kernel `host_processor_info`.
* **💎 Apple-Style Glassmorphism HUD**: Smooth spring-animated `UIVisualEffectView` HUD alert that slides down when thermal and CPU load spikes.
* **⚡️ One-Tap 'Boost & Cool' Rescue**: Instantly purges system memory caches, deprioritizes runaway background daemons (`suggestd`, `passd`, `assetd`), and elevates foreground application priority to `QOS_CLASS_USER_INTERACTIVE`.
* **🎮 Gaming & Telegram Auto-Boost**: Automatically senses MLBB and Telegram entering the foreground and optimizes execution queues.
* **⚙️ Full Settings Integration**: Custom slider thresholds, toggles, and live HUD preview action inside the iOS Settings app.

views.text: iPhone 7 Plus / iPhone 7 (A10 Fusion) & all A9-A15 devices
